implemented_requirements.requirement: Player presses a key to flap and keep the bird from falling
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game.handle_events() maps SPACE or UP to Game.bird.flap() (lines where event.key in (pygame.K_SPACE, pygame.K_UP) triggers self.bird.flap()). Bird.flap() sets velocity to settings.FLAP_STRENGTH, providing upward impulse.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Gravity pulls the bird down when not flapping
implemented_requirements.evidence: Bird.update() adds settings.GRAVITY to self.velocity each frame (line: self.velocity = min(self.velocity + settings.GRAVITY, settings.MAX_FALL_SPEED)) and updates self.y accordingly.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Randomly generated vertical gaps in pipes appear
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game._spawn_pipe() computes a random gap_center using random.uniform within screen margins and creates a Pipe with that gap (gap_center, gap). Pipe stores gap_height and renders top/bottom sections accordingly.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Each successful pass of a pipe increases the score
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game._update_pipes() checks pipe.has_passed(self.bird.x); if true it calls pipe.mark_passed() and increments self.score by 1.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Game ends if the bird collides with a pipe or the ground
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game._check_collisions() calls self._game_over() when bird.hits_ground() or ground.collide(rect) or any pipe.collides(rect) returns True.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Difficulty gradually adjusts by varying gap sizes and pipe speeds
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game.current_difficulty() returns speed and gap based on self.score (speed = PIPE_SPEED_START + score*PIPE_SPEED_PER_POINT, gap = PIPE_GAP_START - score*PIPE_GAP_PER_POINT). These values are used in _spawn_pipe() and for ground/pipe movement.

judge.summary: The provided source implements a functional Flappy Bird clone. Core gameplay mechanics—flap input, gravity, pipe generation with random vertical gaps, scoring on pipe passes, collision detection with pipes and ground, and difficulty scaling via pipe speed and gap size—are all present and wired into the main game loop. The code appears ready to run with pygame, and no missing functionality is observed. Minor concerns are limited to an unrelated file with a syntax error that is not referenced by the game.
